optimizedDescription.value: Authoritative project config via specd.yaml: schema, workspaces, storage, plugins, context, approvals, layered cascade.

optimizedContext.value:
# Config

## Rules
- Discovery: (1) `--config` = explicit file + its `extends` only; (2) walk CWD→VCS root, stop at first dir with candidates; (3) no VCS → CWD only. Candidates order: `specd.yaml`, `specd.*.yaml` alpha, `specd.local.yaml`, `specd.local.*.yaml` alpha. `extends: true` inherits previous layer; `extends: <path>` only if base already in chain. Never above VCS root.
- `privacy`: `mode` `hash|mask|anonymous`; optional `salt`, `excludeActors` (default `["specd","system@getspecd.dev"]`), `allowedMetadataKeys`.
- Env overrides win: `SPECD_ACTOR_PROVIDER`, `SPECD_PRIVACY_SALT`, `SPECD_PRIVACY_MODE` (+ `.env`/`.env.local`).
- Optional `actorProvider` forces named registry provider.
- Cascade: scalars last-wins; objects deep-merge; arrays append unless `remove`. `remove` only with `extends`. Identity: `context[].id`, `plugins.agents[].name`, map keys for workspaces/storage. Required fields (e.g. `schema`) not removable. `specd init` gitignores local variants.
- Required `schema` prefixes: `@pkg`, `#ws:name`, `#name`/bare (=default), path. Resolve at command dispatch; skip for help/version/init/config validate/plugin cmds. Distinct `ConfigValidationError` vs `SchemaNotFoundError`/`SchemaValidationError`.
- Optional `invalidationPolicy`: `none|surgical|downstream|global` — project default for new changes.
- Workspaces: mandatory `default`; names `/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/`; props `specs` (always), `codeRoot` (required non-default), `schemas`, `ownership` (default owned/readOnly), `prefix`, context patterns, graph filters. `isExternal` inferred.
- Workspace `graph`: `allowedPaths`, `respectGitignore` (default true, absolute priority), `excludePaths` (replaces builtins when set).
- Optional `storage` adapters for changes/drafts/discarded/archive; omit → fs defaults under `specdPath`. Named adapters via registry.
- `specdPath` default `.specd`; derive graph/tmp/change-locks. Missing dirs → `StorageDirectoryNotFoundError`.
- Unresolved `{{namespace.key}}` tokens preserved + warning.
- `schemaPlugins` (same ref conventions, `kind: schema-plugin`); `schemaOverrides` = `SchemaOperations` after plugins.
- Context patterns project vs workspace-level; active ws = change has its specs. Order: project context entries → project include/exclude → active ws include/exclude → dependsOn (excludes never apply to deps). Defaults: project include `['default:*']`, ws include `['*']`. Unknown qualifier: warn at runtime, error on `config validate`.
- `contextMode`: `list|summary` (default)|`full|hybrid`; project-level only; no legacy `lazy`.
- `context[]`: instruction or file (+ optional `id`).
- `approvals.spec`/`approvals.signoff` default false.
- Optional `logging.level` (default `info`); `llmOptimizedContext` default false.
- `plugins.agents[]` validated by Zod; `ConfigWriter`: `initProject`, `addPlugin`, `removePlugin`, `listPlugins`.
- Cascade validation failures → `ConfigValidationError`. Legacy shape → non-fatal `SpecdConfig.warnings`.
- Project `graph.includePaths`/`excludePaths`; includePaths → `root:` unless owned by workspace codeRoot.

## Constraints
- Every field Zod-validated at load.
- `privacy.mode=hash` requires salt (config or env) or validation fails.
- Unknown top-level fields rejected (strict Zod).
